page.layout: One page of text in one column, with the running head above it. The catchword stands at the right below the last line. No notes in the margins. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is left out.

main_text.p: Ecclesiâ obtinebat pertinere non dubitâ-bit, qui eos accuratè legerit: 3. Nulla igi-tur adferri potest idonea causa ob quam Codici Canonum Ecclesiæ universæ in-serti sunt Canones Ancyrani & Neocæsa-riensēs, Apostolici nequaquam, præter istam quod scilicet nundum confi&i erant Canones Pseudapostolici & in unum cor-pus colle&i. 4. Denique si colle&tores Ca-nonum Ecclesiæ universæ, colle&tioni suæ inserere noluissent, hunc Canonum Eccle-siæ primitivæ Codicem, ut illum indigetat Beveregius, vel ut loquitur Albaspinæus hoc Breviarium ac Epitomen Ecclesiasti-corum ante Nicænam Synodum apud Græcos Decretorum: Alicubi saltem honorificam illius mentionem erant facturi, ne adeo venerandum antiquitatis Ecclesiasticæ mo-numentum ab illis contemptum videretur; quod cùm nullibi fecerint, certò certius est eis prorsus incognitam fuisse hanc Ca-nonum Apostolicorum Syllogen: In Co-dice Canonum Ecclesiæ Africanæ, inquit, nullum è decretis, quæ sub Cypriano aliis-que veteustioribus [?] Africæ Conciliis divul-gata fuerant, continetur, forte, immò contrarium plane liquet ex Epistolis Cy-priani in quibus cernere est eadem adver-sus Transmarinas appellationes decreta quæ in Codice leguntur Africano præte-rea

page.notes: The running head is partly covered by a black ink blot; the word after "in" is unreadable. A large blot also covers part of the line "Albaspinæus / hoc" and the line "Cypriano aliis-" near the right margin, but the letters there are legible. "veteustioribus" is read as printed and is doubtful (perhaps a misprint for "veterioribus"). The catchword "rea" is read as printed; the macron, if any, is not clear. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and the digitiser's watermark, which are left out.
